title: "Hardware audit" phishing wave rides the Coldcard hack — fake Coinkite emails install remote-access malware
summary: Within days of the July 2026 Coldcard seed-entropy disclosure, phishing campaigns began impersonating Coldcard/Coinkite with 'hardware audit' emails linking to cloned sites. The 'Start Hardware Audit' button installs ScreenConnect remote-access software; parallel scams push seed 'checker' pages. Hardware wallet vendors industry-wide issued warnings. Scared users are the target — panic is the payload.

entities.vendor: Coinkite (impersonated — not at fault for this wave)

timeline.event: Coinkite discloses the seed-entropy flaw; mass media coverage creates a scared, primed audience.
Proofpoint-tracked campaigns send fake Coldcard 'hardware audit' emails; cloned Coinkite sites serve ScreenConnect remote-access installers.
Hardware wallet makers across the industry publish phishing warnings.

affected: Anyone whose email/handle is associated with Bitcoin or who publicly discussed the Coldcard hack
Users searching for 'coldcard firmware update' and clicking sponsored/ad results
notAffected: Nobody is 'not affected' by phishing — but users who never type a seed anywhere except their hardware device cannot lose funds to a seed-harvest page
actions: There is no such thing as a remote 'hardware audit'. Any email offering one is an attack. Delete it.
Never type your seed phrase into ANY website, app, or 'checker' — including ones that look like the vendor. A seed leaves the device only as pen on paper (or steel).
Get firmware only by typing coinkite.com manually. Never click ad/sponsored search results for wallet software.
If you already ran a 'hardware audit' installer: disconnect the machine, assume total compromise, move funds using a clean device with a fresh seed, then rebuild the machine.
Vendor support will never DM you first, never ask for your seed, and never rush you. Urgency is the tell.

claims.claim: Campaigns tracked by Proofpoint deliver ScreenConnect via cloned Coinkite 'Start Hardware Audit' pages.

phrases: coinkite email asking to verify wallet
